SELQIE API

This module provides the primary Python interface to the SELQIE electronic structure methods.

The module exposes a single entry point, solve, which can be used to run CISD, FCI, or selected CI calculations.

solve

Source: main.f90:L14-L71

solve(method, sel_method, n_orb, n_up, n_down, h_int, g_int, nuc_rep, conv, epsilon, cmin, energy, n_basis)

Main solving routine for all electronic structure methods implemented in SELQIE.

Depending on the value of method, the routine performs a CISD, FCI, or SCI calculation and returns the resulting ground-state energy.

For selected CI calculations, the final determinant basis and CI coefficients are stored internally for later access from Python.

Parameters

method : character(len=*)

Electronic structure method to use.

Supported values:

  • "cisd"

  • "fci"

  • "sci"

sel_method : character(len=*)

Selection scheme used when method="sci".

n_orb : integer

Number of spatial orbitals.

n_up : integer

Number of alpha electrons.

n_down : integer

Number of beta electrons.

h_int : real(kind=dp), dimension(:,:)

One-electron integrals in the spin-orbital basis.

g_int : real(kind=dp), dimension(:,:,:,:)

Two-electron integrals in the spin-orbital basis.

nuc_rep : real(kind=dp)

Nuclear repulsion energy.

conv : real(kind=dp)

Convergence threshold used by selected CI methods.

epsilon : real(kind=dp)

Selection threshold parameter.

cmin : real(kind=dp)

Minimum coefficient threshold used during determinant selection.

Returns

energy : real(kind=dp)

Total electronic energy plus nuclear repulsion energy.

n_basis : integer

Number of determinants in the final wavefunction expansion.

Internal Storage

Source: main.f90:L8-L11

The module stores the final selected-CI wavefunction internally for later retrieval.

stored_basis : integer(kind=8), allocatable, dimension(:,:)

Determinant basis generated by the most recent SCI calculation.

stored_coeffs : real(kind=dp), allocatable, dimension(:)

CI coefficients corresponding to stored_basis.
